nodes.skill_target: compare responsible translation/textual forms without penalizing the player
nodes.why_this_node_exists: deepens the final campaign's textual-variant skill while preserving the no-penalty policy.
nodes.player_prompt: Порівняйте два відповідальні переклади в одному з активних `TX1` місць і поясніть, чому різниця не повинна перетворюватися на помилку користувача.
nodes.source_scope_visible_to_player: one active TX1 passage selected from the campaign; Mark 14:68/72 is the canonical regression fixture.
nodes.accepted_answer: Identify the variant-sensitive wording, state that both responsible forms are recognized, and keep the textual_variant_flag separate from confidence_code; no originality verdict is required.
nodes.accepted_variants: equivalent no-penalty explanation preserving proposition and provenance.
nodes.required_evidence: TEXTUAL_VARIANT_POLICY v1.0 + selected passage textual note; regression fixture includes ESV 2025 and NET notes for Mark 14:68/72.
nodes.rejected_answers: declaring a responsible translation wrong solely for following another textual decision; merging TX1 into confidence_code.
nodes.success_feedback: TX1 translation check complete: variant shown before grading and mastery result is unchanged across responsible forms.
nodes.partial_feedback: Якщо варіант розпізнано, але grading policy неправильний, виправте лише policy.
nodes.failure_feedback: Прочитайте textual note before grading; question is not asking you to decide originality.

hints.H5: No penalty for a responsible form.

nodes.mastery_mode: independent; H6/H7 or answer reveal records guided mastery
nodes.functional_nonvisual_equivalent: Two translations are ordinary labelled text blocks; TX1 note is literal text and announced before grading.
